newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Blue chips pull down Manila share index at close.
newsitem.headline: Blue chips pull down Manila share index at close.

text.p: * Value turnover moderate at 2.23 billion pesos
The Manila share index shaved off 82.13 points, or 2.96 percent, to 2,694.40 points on Wednesday due to massive sales in first-liner issues that had raked gains in the past two days, traders said.
"Although the market was up on Tuesday there were already signs of profit-taking and we just saw a continuation," said Henry Ong, dealer at Sapphire Securities.
Losers hammered gainers 110 to 20 and all sub-indices fell sharply led by the commercial-industrial index.
At one point, the main index briefly plunged 3.06 percent to 2,692.29 points.
Traders said the correction was expected as the market's barometer had surged by 170.88 points, or 6.55 percent, to 2,776.53 in just two days from Friday's 2,605,65.
Index heavyweights PLDT, Meralco B, Petron Corp, Ayala Land Inc, San Miguel Corp B and Ayala Corp B helped the index' fall.
"This is a bad sign. This decline will likely continue until tommorrow and we may even test the 2,600 support," said Ong.
Peregrine Securities dealer Poch Zamora said the market may resume watching the Dow's movements on lack of domestic news to spur buying.
